notes: Document-level relevance judgments for the research-papers benchmark corpus. A chunk is treated as a hit for a query if its source document's filename appears in relevant_documents. Categories follow the Retrieval Evaluation v1 matrix: semantic, acronym, exact_keyword, code_entity. q1-q20 cover the original 5-paper corpus (paper-001..005). q21-q160 (2026-08-11) cover the 45 papers added in paper-006..050, grouped into topic clusters (music/AI, mental health, cultural events, quantum computing, statistics education, climate change, personal finance, Sri Lanka language policy, seismic/tsunami, extraterrestrial life, misc/futurism) with cross-document queries wherever a question is genuinely answerable from multiple papers in the same cluster. Drafted by parallel research agents grounded directly in each paper's processed_document.json content, then verified programmatically: every retrieval_documents entry resolves to a real corpus filename.
